summary: Simultaneous role transition and VPN rekey request for remote employee handoff
description:
Issue summary:
A senior ML engineer (Samira Patel) is undergoing a role transition to an external contractor-backed advisory position while simultaneously preparing for a temporary remote exit from the primary office (EU->APAC travel window). HR has requested IT to: rotate VPN pre-shared keys and reissue new SSH certs, update role-based groups, and coordinate secure handoff of a loaner GPU laptop to a local vendor for temporary testing. The change must not interrupt production service accounts and needs to preserve access for a limited handover window (48 hours) for the new team lead.

Impact:
- Potential brief loss of VPN/SSH access for Samira during rekeying if not coordinated (blocked debugging for ongoing A/B rollout).
- Risk of stale credentials if hardware is shipped without KMS/HSM key confirm.
- Policy question: can we issue a time-limited elevated 'handover' access token for 48 hours to the outgoing employee, or must access be revoked immediately on role change?

Environment:
- Prod (us-east) services: auth-redwood (SSO), vpn-redwood-eu, bastion-us-east-01.
- Employee primary account: samira.patel@redwood.ai (SSO).

Requested actions:
1) Plan and execute VPN PSK rotation for affected gateways with scheduled fallback windows.
2) Reissue short-lived SSH certs (24-48h) scoped to 'handover' role.
3) Confirm KMS tagging and device escrow steps for the loaner GPU laptop being shipped to APAC vendor.
4) Clarify policy: recommended practice for simultaneous role change + temporary access for knowledge transfer.

Steps/Attachments:
- HR ticket: HR-2026-03-09-87 (copied below).
- Proposed handover window: 2026-03-11 09:00 UTC -> 2026-03-13 09:00 UTC.
- Employee note: will be on travel with intermittent connectivity; contactable via company Slack and personal mobile.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Khan: Created ticket after HR request. Added proposed handover window. Asked Security for guidance on time-limited elevated tokens.

2026-03-10 - Diego Ramos (Security): Need more detail on exact VPN gateways and any overlapping service accounts. Recommend no long-lived PSK; schedule rotation during low traffic window and pre-seed new PSK on devices where possible.

2026-03-11 - Lucas Meyer (Assignee): Confirmed inventory of loaner laptop (TAG: HW-APAC-0042). Will run KMS tag audit and prepare escrow package. Planning rekey for 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC with 30m maintenance window and immediate rollback plan.

2026-03-11 - Samira Patel (Employee): Confirms acceptance of proposed handover window and that the new team lead (Diego Nguyen) will be present for knowledge transfer. Requests SSH certs to allow immediate access to debug pipeline only.

2026-03-12 - Security (Diego Ramos): Policy note: short-lived certs acceptable for 48 hours if scope-limited and logged. Require approval from HR and Engineering manager; recommend additional MFA check for cert issuance.

2026-03-12 - Lucas Meyer: Executed partial actions: prepared escrow note, created PR to pre-seed VPN PSK on eu gateway, and created short-lived SSH certs for samira.patel scoped to 'handover:debug' with 48h expiry. Awaiting HR approval email to proceed with live rotation.
investigation_notes: Checked inventory: HW-APAC-0042 present in asset-management and flagged for courier. Verified with KMS that device has last-rotation tag 2025-12-02. Reviewed vpn-redwood-eu gateway configs; new PSK pre-seed PR created: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/9f4b2c4. Confirmed there are no active long-lived service accounts tied to samira.patel that would break on rotation (scanned via iam-audit script). Identified two buildkite agents that use host-level keys; these were scheduled for separate follow-up with Buildkite Ops to swap to token-based auth before PSK rotation.
resolution:
Work performed so far:
- Short-lived SSH certs issued (48h) scoped to 'handover:debug'.
- KMS escrow package prepared and courier scheduled; device tagged 'in-transit'.
- VPN PSK rotation staged: PR merged to pre-seed new key on vpn-redwood-eu. Planned cutover: 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC with 30m monitor.
Policy decision and follow-ups:
- Security approved time-limited handover access with MFA and strict scope; HR approved the handover window via email (HR-approver: Priya Menon).
- Action items: 1) Buildkite Ops to migrate two agents to token auth (linked: INT-314159). 2) Run post-rotation validation runbook and collect logs (confluence runbook link below).
- Ticket status: In Progress while waiting for Buildkite Ops completion and post-rotation validation. Will close once device confirmed delivered and Buildkite migration done.
